Players Committee card image of [[Black 2 (V)]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may take one Pride Of The Empire into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
